title: Safe AI at scale, what happens after initial access, and the weekly enterprise news  - ESW #463
description:
Interview with Shiva Pillay from Veeam

Safe AI at Scale

AI investment is exploding, yet nearly 90% of enterprise initiatives fail because the data powering AI cannot be trusted. That’s the uncomfortable truth the industry is facing right now. Safe AI at scale requires more than just great models—it demands trusted, governed, and recoverable data.

This segment is sponsored by Veeam. Visit https://securityweekly.com/veeam to learn more about them!

Segment resources:

-Veeam Launches New Data and AI Trust Maturity Model to Help Organizations Benchmark AI Readiness: https://www.veeam.com/company/press-release/veeam-launches-new-data-and-ai-trust-maturity-model-to-help-organizations-benchmark-ai-readiness.html

Topic: Sure, we know how initial access works, but what about lateral movement?

A special topic segment where we're joined by Albert Estevez Polo, field CTO for Zero Networks (a community guest, not a podcast sponsor). Zero Networks just released some very interesting data on what attackers are doing after they gain access to victim's environments and how they're doing it.

Segment Resources:

-Link to report page: https://zeronetworks.com/resource-center/reports/2026-lateral-movement-exposure-report?utm_medium=pr&utm_source=zero_networks&utm_campaign=lmer_and_blast_radius_tool_pr

Weekly Enterprise Security News

Finally, in the enterprise security news, 

1. Funding and acquisitions
2. Good news, Mythos isn’t dangerous anymore!
3. An excellent breach analysis
4. Cyber insurance rates are dropping, but there’s a catch
5. CISA updates vulnerability remediation guidance
6. Zoom calls are worse than you think, and maybe not for the reasons you think
7. Remember when it was illegal to rip DVDs?

All that and more, on this episode of Enterprise Security Weekly.

Visit https://www.securityweekly.com/esw for all the latest episodes!
